jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer
to join a small, highly experienced Epicor Labs team that transforms innovative AI concepts into enterprise-grade products trusted by enterprise customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role
, not a management position. You will design and build, set the technical bar for production quality, and provide the architectural judgement needed to take AI-driven products from promising prototype to something enterprise customers can trust with their business data.

What You'll Do

As a Principal Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering the next generation of AI capabilities across Epicor's ERP portfolio.

PoCs and MVPs in AI transformation projects inside enterprise ERP software - rapid exploration of new capabilities, with the engineering discipline to evolve the successful ones into production-grade services.
Cloud platform services - designing and building the services, APIs, and data layers that new AI capabilities run on, integrating with large, established ERP products.
Production readiness - bringing R&D output up to enterprise standard: reliability, observability, security, multi-tenancy, and safe failure behaviour.
AI engineering - integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into business software responsibly: guardrails, permissions, auditability, and designing for the probabilistic nature of AI components acting on real business data.
Raising the bar - architectural review across the team's workstreams, mentoring engineers at all levels, and turning good judgement into standards and automation rather than tribal knowledge.

What You Are Likely To Bring

Principal-level engineering depth in C#/.NET and/or Python, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), and a strong record of designing and shipping production services. Our systems span both stacks - strength in one with working fluency in the other is the expectation.
Production TypeScript/JavaScript frontend engineering experience, including building secure, accessible user interfaces that integrate with enterprise web shells, APIs and backend services.
Experience designing and integrating enterprise information systems, with a strong understanding of data flows, system boundaries and the operational impact of change.
Ability to work effectively with data scientists and other AI specialists to turn data, models and experimentation into reliable, usable product capabilities.
Production ownership experience - you have run systems in production and carry the instincts that come from it: partial failure, resilience, blast-radius thinking, and designing for the incident nobody planned. This matters to us more than any specific framework.
Distributed-systems fluency: service boundaries, transactional thinking, multi-tenant design, API design and versioning.
Strong architectural communication - able to explain, document, and defend design decisions across teams, and to review others' designs constructively.
Pragmatism under real-world constraints: comfortable integrating with large, long-lived enterprise systems and choosing the achievable-good over the theoretical-perfect.

Highly Desirable

Hands-on exposure to AI-assisted engineering - building with LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, and prompt-driven workflows, and a grounded view of where they help and where they don't.
Experience taking early-stage products (PoC/MVP) to production, ideally in enterprise software.
AWS experience.
Complex business-domain experience - ERP, e-commerce, finance, logistics - and an appreciation of the cost of getting business data wrong.
Security instincts: least privilege, tenancy isolation, trust boundaries.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 3 months, you'll:

Deliver production-quality code
Own components from design through implementation
Contribute architectural improvements across the team

Within 6–12 Months, You'll

Lead the design of major platform capabilities
Become a trusted technical leader and architectural reference point
Mentor engineers and help raise engineering standards across Epicor Labs

About Epicor Labs

Epicor Labs is the innovation engine behind AI transformation across Epicor's ERP portfolio.

Our team explores new ideas, rapidly prototypes solutions, and turns successful concepts into production-ready capabilities before handing them over to product engineering teams.

We're a Small, Senior Team With

High autonomy
Minimal bureaucracy
Fast decision-making
Strong engineering standards
A collaborative culture where the best ideas win, regardless of title

You'll work alongside experienced architects, product managers, UX designers, and AI specialists to solve challenging technical problems with real customer impact.

Technology

C# / .NET
Python
Azure
TypeScript / JavaScript
REST & GraphQL APIs
Relational & document databases
GitHub with CI/CD pipelines
LLM APIs
AI-assisted development tools

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
Internal Mobility: Opportunities for mentorship, continuing education, and focused career goal setting, with 25% of positions filled internally.
Career Development: Free LinkedIn Learning licenses for everyone, along with our Mentoring Program to boost your personal development.
Education Support: Geographically specific programs to balance the cost of education with the benefits of continued learning and personal development.
Inclusive Workplace: Collaborate with a diverse team in an inclusive, global workplace that fosters innovation and celebrates partnership.
Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.
Global Mobility: Comprehensive support for international relocations and permanent residency processes.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer. 

Recruiter

Alena Jelinkova

jobs.title: Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Vice President, AI-Augmented Full-Stack Engineer

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. This role is located in Manchester.

You’ll join a team committed to delivering quality through TDD, Continuous Integration, and extensive automation. The team drives best practices department-wide, and you should be confident in promoting these standards.

The ideal candidate enjoys collaborating to solve technical challenges, leading workshops, and mentoring junior team members to enhance skills and growth.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

Champion Engineering 2.0 practices by embedding AI-augmented development workflows across the team, driving measurable gains in velocity, quality, and innovation
Leverage AI coding assistants (Windsurf, Claude Code) and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) to accelerate software delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and elevate engineering standards
Design, build, and deploy intelligent, scalable solutions that integrate machine learning models, event streaming pipelines, and cloud-native services on Azure and AWS
Architect and implement data platforms using Snowflake for analytics and reporting, ensuring seamless integration with broader enterprise data ecosystems
Build and maintain real-time event streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, Azure Event Hubs) to power high-throughput, low-latency financial data flows
Deliver robust full-stack solutions utilising .NET/C# and SQL where appropriate, ensuring clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack
Lead technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions on AI-augmented development, machine learning integration, and modern cloud patterns
Mentor and uplift team members in adopting AI-driven engineering practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and experimentation
Partner with Architecture and Data Science teams to define best practices for ML model deployment, data pipeline design, and cloud infrastructure standards
Conduct thorough code reviews with a focus on AI-assisted quality, providing constructive feedback to enhance code quality and team expertise
Collaborate with the team and wider development community to cultivate Agile mindsets and practices, driving effective and adaptive workflows

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:

Demonstrated experience as an AI-augmented developer, with proficiency in tools such as Windsurf, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocols (MCPs) to accelerate engineering delivery
Strong understanding of Engineering 2.0 principles – using AI and intelligent automation to fundamentally enhance how software is designed, built, tested, and deployed
Hands-on experience with machine learning concepts and the ability to integrate ML models into production applications and data pipelines
Proficiency with Snowflake for data warehousing, analytics, and building scalable data platforms
Experience designing and building event streaming architectures using technologies such as Apache Kafka and Azure Event Hubs
Strong working knowledge of Azure and/or AWS cloud services, including compute, storage, serverless, and container orchestration (e.g., AKS, EKS, Azure Functions, Lambda)
Solid experience with .NET/C# and SQL Server for building enterprise-grade applications and data access layers
Expert knowledge of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, CQRS)
Experience and knowledge in Agile delivery (ideally with Scrum experience)
Experience delivering high-volume, highly available enterprise applications in regulated environments
Strong knowledge of TDD, Continuous Integration, and automation practices
Experience with modern CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tooling
Ability to critically analyse designs and code, providing constructive and actionable feedback
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:

BNY Newsroom

BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Synechron is looking for an end-to-end solution architecture (compute, networking, security, resilience) for applications, largely On-Prem , AWS-hosted, some Azure.

The role is weighted roughly 80% architecture governance & compliance
— authoring SDD/ADD/ASA governance documentation, driving designs through the ARB/ITT/PTO/GOVID process, and coordinating across SecArch, Risk & Compliance, and infra/vendor stakeholders and 20% technical expertise
.

Role
:
Author governance documentation - SDD, ADD, ASA, HLD - and take designs through our internal ARB/governance process
Hands-on knowledge of IAC , CI/CD, Terraform, pipelines personally, not just review/approve others' work.
Kubernetes/EKS migration design, including ownership of on-prem to cloud migrations end-to-end
IAM/IDM design and security reviews (Okta/SailPoint/Entra-type tooling)
Work closely across architecture, risk/compliance, and infra teams daily, so collaboration style matters as much as technical depth
Strong team player in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment

Must-haves:

Financial services / regulated environment experience

Can PROVE hands-on experience
, owning end-to-end solution design not - designed it and a team built it
Has personally owned an EKS/Kubernetes migration end-to-end (not just coached/advised one)
Has AUTHORED governance docs, not just reviewed/signed off on them
Specific experience and examples of architecture decisions, trade-offs, ownership

Nice-to-have:
index/benchmark/market-data platform experience, data migration experience (DMS, Sybase/Mongo to Aurora-type work).

This is a long term rolling contract - x3 days as week in London office - Strong market rates inside IR35

Diversity Statement

Synechron are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We offer flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programmes to support our global workforce. Empowerment and collaboration are at the core of how we operate.

All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Cloud Developer
jobs.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title:
Cloud Developer

Location:
Cambridge, United Kingdom (Hybrid)

Employment Type:
Full-time

The job

We are seeking a Cloud Developer to join the AVEVA Unified Supply Chain R&D team, where you will play a key role in developing and evolving vital infrastructure that supports key customer workflows. You will work as part of an enthusiastic and engaged development team to build robust and reliable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate closely in a team environment to deliver high quality improvements to existing infrastructure platform
Contribute to design of infrastructure improvements, balancing robust technical solutions with business value
Diagnose and fix issues affecting production infrastructure, supported by experienced colleagues
Proactively identify and communicate technical issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement

Essential Requirements

Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) development
Proficiency in scripting with Powershell or similar
Experience and understanding of core Azure services: compute, storage, security, monitoring and diagnostics
A proactive self-starting approach, owning work through to production
Strong communication and collaboration skills

Desired Skills And Competencies

C#/.NET experience

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.
